title: The tagged photo
premise: Daughter says she stayed in studying; Mummy says a cousin tagged her at a cafe, and Mummy has already liked the photo.

script.text: Riya tagged you in a photo.
The one with the cold coffee. I liked it.

caption: mummy already liked it

post.caption: The like is what kills me. Send this to your mumma before she sees your tags.
post.youtubeTitle: When Mummy sees the tagged photo
